string.text: Persistent Stalkers
Your character, kept on this computer
Enable constant saves (Warning: may break the game)

Off (the default): your character follows the save. The profile is written each time you save, and loading a save played with it gives you the character from that save: die and reload, and you have what you had at that save. Any other game gets the profile as it was at your last save. On: your character lives in the profile. It is written whenever it changes, and every game you load or join gives you that character, whatever the save holds. Loading an older save rolls back the world, not you, so things picked up since that save are in the world again, and other mods that expect the save's inventory may be confused. Either way, health and bleeding stay with the save. The profile, or None for no profile at all, is chosen at the main menu. Takes effect at once.
What the character carries (gear always)
Money
Your money is set to the profile's.
Rank and reputation
Rank and reputation are set to the profile's.
Faction goodwill
Each faction's goodwill toward you is set to the profile's. How factions feel about each other stays with the world.
Faction (experimental)
Your true faction is set to the profile's. Relations between factions belong to the world and do not change. Untested in co-op: the host may set your faction back.
Hunger, thirst and sleep
Hunger, thirst and sleepiness are set to the profile's.
Skills
Skill levels and experience (Skill System) are set to the profile's.
Class and perks
Skill tree: the class, the perks bought, the XP of every class and the secondary craft are set to the profile's. Only when Skill tree is enabled; without it the profile keeps what it has.
Crafting recipes
Recipes the profile knows are learned. Recipes already known in this game stay known.
Death takes the carried gear

Only with constant saves on, and only when nothing else keeps you alive (DANTE, Azazel, Soulslike). Off: after a death and reload you have the gear you carried a moment before dying. Health and bleeding are the save's. On: the profile loses everything you carried except the binoculars, PDA and torch you have equipped.
